name: scaffold-hbar-metered-mcp
description: Metered MCP server on Hedera: every tool call settles in HBAR on testnet and writes an HCS usage receipt.

create-scaffold-hbar.instructions: Copy .env.example to .env, set METER_TREASURY_ACCOUNT to your testnet account, fund it from the Hedera Portal faucet, then run yarn install and yarn next:start. Open http://localhost:3000 and follow the setup flow: try the free ping, pay for a metered call, view receipts.

envVars.name: METER_TREASURY_ACCOUNT
envVars.description: Testnet account that receives per-call HBAR payments, for example 0.0.123456.

envVars.name: METER_PRICE_TINYBAR
envVars.description: Price per paid MCP tool call in tinybar. Default 10000.

envVars.name: HCS_RECEIPT_TOPIC_ID
envVars.description: Testnet HCS topic for usage receipts, for example 0.0.789012.

envVars.name: HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID
envVars.description: Testnet operator account id for submitting HCS receipts. Optional.

envVars.name: HEDERA_OPERATOR_KEY
envVars.description: Testnet operator private key for submitting HCS receipts. Optional, never commit.

create-scaffold-hbar.outro: Metered MCP template ready. Run yarn next:start, open http://localhost:3000, and pay for your first tool call on Hedera testnet. Verify payments and receipts on HashScan.
